title: Writing: 5 Things I Have (Never) Done
writingModel: I have had many interesting experiences in my life, but there are still plenty of things I want to try. Here are five things I have done and five things I have never done yet.

I have been to the Charyn Canyon in southeastern Kazakhstan. I went there last summer with my cousin. The red rocks were absolutely breathtaking. I have also performed in front of an audience — I sang at my school graduation concert in 2022. It was terrifying but also the most exciting thing I had ever done at that point.

I have learned to cook three traditional Kazakh dishes: beshbarmak, samsa, and plov. My grandmother taught me. I have never managed to make them as well as she does, but I keep trying! I have also studied French for six months. I haven't become fluent yet, but I can hold a basic conversation.

As for things I have never done: I have never been abroad. I've applied for an exchange programme, but I haven't been accepted yet. I have also never learned to drive — I keep planning to start lessons, but I haven't booked them yet. I have never tried sushi, even though my friends say it's delicious.
But every item on this list is a future adventure. I have already started planning which ones to try first. The world is full of experiences waiting to be discovered.
